label: At the reading world w, whatever is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to something other than itself…, via esse cause
description: Composes the stage-one premise that the simply prior causes the esse of what is posterior with the esse-cause bridge: a distinct simply prior y causes the esse of x, x is an actual concretum, so y is an actual concrete ground of x. Only the posterior relatum's actuality is used from the relata premise.
